headline: Gold edges up ₹11 today; silver flat at ₹2,05,000 per kg
summary: Today's 24k gold rose ₹11 per gram (about 0.08%) to ₹14,357, a very small move. Over the last 7 days gold is up ₹469 (3.38%), and over the 13 days in the data it is up ₹82, while silver is flat today at ₹2,05,000 per kg, up ₹5,000 over 7 days but down ₹15,000 since 26 October. Gold recently touched ₹14,602 on 5 November, and the dollar price of gold and the rupee exchange rate are the likely drivers, with festive and wedding demand also a possible factor.
outlook: Prices are close to the recent range, so compare the making charges and GST at your jeweller before buying rather than rushing based on one day's move.
